Sol.208.(b) Harmony -a state of peaceful existence and agreement. Feud a prolonged and bitter quarrel. Humility the quality of having a modest or low view of one's importance. Humble not arrogant or assertive.
Sol.209.(a)  Dependence  reliance  on something or someone. Autonomy -self-governance or independence. Permanence -the state of lasting indefinitely. Independence  freedom  from  outside control or support. Economical -being careful about spending or using resources efficiently.
Sol.210.(d) Serenity -calmness or peacefulness. Annoyance - irritation or displeasure. Susceptibility -  the  likelihood  of  being affected or influenced. Absurdity -something ridiculous or illogical. Gnawer -  an  animal  that  chews  or bites persistently, typically a rodent.
Sol.211.(b) Liberal - open to new ideas.
Dogmatic -stubbornly adhering to a particular set of beliefs. Concerned - worried about something. Conservative - holding traditional views. Diplomatic -skilled in dealing with sensitive matters.
